title: Meng Xin and his ox
text: 1 Long ago, there was a poor man. His name was Meng Xin.
He had a sick old ox.
2 One day, Meng Xin was away from home. His nephew sold the ox. Meng Xin came back home. He did not see the ox.
Meng Xin: Where's the ox? Did you sell it?
Nephew: Yes, I did. We need the money to buy food!
sentences: Long ago, there was a poor man.
One day, Meng Xin was away from home.
We need the money to buy food!
